apps.name: Homepage
apps.subtitle: Native shell for the Blinky dashboard
apps.localizedDescription: A native WKWebView shell for the Blinky Homepage dashboard, built for iPhone Duo. Homepage and every linked app stay in one webview, with full-screen Duo layout, Home/Back/Forward/Reload, OAuth/SSO popups, passkey session import, and the Tautulli/Plex fixes.

versions.localizedDescription: Homepage 1.0.10: lower toolbar, draggable collapsed menu with saved position, and a maximum-scale zoom lock so focusing inputs in Audiobookshelf/Achew no longer zooms.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Homepage connects to your self-hosted apps on the local network.
